properties.displayName: File Event ASIM filtering parser for CrowdStrike Falcon Data Replicator
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    targetfilepath_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    srcfilepath_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    hashes_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    dvchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    CrowdStrike_File_Events_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
    | where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
    // The source has neither an initiating source IP nor a device hostname.
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 and array_length(dvchostname_has_any) == 0
    | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
    | where array_length(srcfilepath_has_any) == 0 or SourceFileName has_any (srcfilepath_has_any)
    | where array_length(hashes_has_any) == 0 or SHA256HashData has_any (hashes_has_any)
    | extend EventType = case(
        event_simpleName == "DirectoryCreate", "FolderCreated",
        event_simpleName in ("NewExecutableRenamed", "RansomwareRenameFile"), "FileRenamed",
        event_simpleName in ("CriticalFileAccessed", "RansomwareOpenFile"), "FileAccessed",
        event_simpleName in ("CriticalFileModified", "AsepFileChange"), "FileModified",
        event_simpleName in ("NewExecutableWritten", "NewScriptWritten", "RansomwareCreateFile"), "FileCreated",
        "FileCreatedOrModified")
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | extend _TargetFilePath = case(
        isempty(TargetFileName) and EventType == "FolderCreated", TargetDirectoryName,
        isnotempty(TargetFileName) and TargetFileName !contains "/" and TargetFileName !contains @"\"
            and isnotempty(TargetDirectoryName),
            strcat(TargetDirectoryName,
                iff(TargetDirectoryName endswith "/" or TargetDirectoryName endswith @"\", "",
                    iff(event_platform in ("Lin", "Mac") or TargetDirectoryName startswith "/", "/", @"\")),
                TargetFileName),
        TargetFileName)
    | where array_length(targetfilepath_has_any) == 0 or _TargetFilePath has_any (targetfilepath_has_any)
    | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
        "SourceAdditionalFields", AdditionalFields,
        "CrowdStrike", bag_pack(
            "ContextTimeStamp", ContextTimeStamp, "name", name, "ConfigBuild", ConfigBuild,
            "ClientId", ClientId, "Status", Status, "OriginalFilename", OriginalFilename,
            "FileWrittenFlags", FileWrittenFlags, "OperationFlags", OperationFlags,
            "IsOnRemovableDisk", IsOnRemovableDisk, "MinorFunction", MinorFunction,
            "IsOnNetwork", IsOnNetwork, "FileIdentifier", FileIdentifier,
            "TokenType", TokenType, "DiskParentDeviceInstanceId", DiskParentDeviceInstanceId,
            "FileObject", FileObject, "IrpFlags", IrpFlags, "FileEcpBitmask", FileEcpBitmask,
            "MajorFunction", MajorFunction, "TemporaryFileName", TemporaryFileName,
            "VolumeSessionUUID", VolumeSessionUUID, "PatternId", PatternId,
            "EventOrigin", EventOrigin, "MSOfficeSubType", MSOfficeSubType, "GID", GID,
            "UnixMode", UnixMode, "USN", USN, "FileCategory", FileCategory,
            "ShareAccess", ShareAccess, "DesiredAccess", DesiredAccess, "ELFSubType", ELFSubType,
            "IsTransactedFile", IsTransactedFile, "MachOSubType", MachOSubType,
            "VnodeModificationType", VnodeModificationType, "NewFileIdentifier", NewFileIdentifier,
            "Options", Options, "Information", Information, "FileAttributes", FileAttributes,
            "Tags", Tags, "FixedFileVersion", FixedFileVersion,
            "HandleCreateAuthenticationId", HandleCreateAuthenticationId, "FileFlags", FileFlags,
            "VnodeType", VnodeType, "ConfigStateHash", ConfigStateHash,
            "ContextThreadId", ContextThreadId, "BoundingLimitCount", BoundingLimitCount,
            "BoundingLimitDuration", BoundingLimitDuration, "Entitlements", Entitlements,
            "EffectiveTransmissionClass", EffectiveTransmissionClass,
            "OciContainerId", OciContainerId, "TreeId", TreeId,
            "TenantId", TenantId, "_ResourceId", _ResourceId)), dynamic({}))
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalType = event_simpleName,
        EventOriginalUid = CrowdStrikeId,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = Status,
        DvcId = aid,
        DvcIpAddr = aip,
        DvcScopeId = cid,
        ActorUsername = UserName,
        ActorUserSid = FileOperatorSid,
        ActorUserUid = UID,
        ActorSessionId = AuthenticationId,
        ActingProcessId = ContextProcessId,
        ActingProcessName = ImageFileName,
        ActingProcessCommandLine = CommandLine,
        TargetFileDirectory = TargetDirectoryName,
        TargetFileSize = Size,
        TargetFileSHA256 = SHA256HashData,
        SrcFilePath = SourceFileName,
        TargetFilePath = _TargetFilePath
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp), TimeGenerated),
        DvcOs = case(event_platform == "Win", "Windows", event_platform == "Lin", "Linux",
            event_platform == "Mac", "macOS", ""),
        ActorUserId = coalesce(ActorUserSid, ActorUserUid),
        ActorUserIdType = case(isnotempty(ActorUserSid), "SID", isnotempty(ActorUserUid), "UID", ""),
        ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(ActorUsername), "", ActorUsername startswith "CN=", "DN",
            ActorUsername contains @"\", "Windows", ActorUsername contains "@", "UPN", "Simple"),
        DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", "")
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        EventUid = EventOriginalUid,
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = "CrowdStrike",
        EventProduct = "Falcon Data Replicator",
        EventSchema = "FileEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventResult = "NA",
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, DvcIpAddr),
        TargetFileName = tostring(split(replace_string(TargetFilePath, @"\", "/"), "/")[-1]),
        SrcFileName = tostring(split(replace_string(SrcFilePath, @"\", "/"), "/")[-1]),
        TargetFilePathType = case(isempty(TargetFilePath), "", TargetFilePath startswith @"\\", "Windows Share",
            TargetFilePath startswith "/", "Unix", TargetFilePath contains @"\", "Windows Local",
            TargetFilePath contains "://", "URL", "FileNameOnly"),
        SrcFilePathType = case(isempty(SrcFilePath), "", SrcFilePath startswith @"\\", "Windows Share",
            SrcFilePath startswith "/", "Unix", SrcFilePath contains @"\", "Windows Local",
            SrcFilePath contains "://", "URL", ""),
        HashType = iff(isnotempty(TargetFileSHA256), "SHA256", ""),
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        ActingProcessEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        SrcFileEntityKey = "",
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetFileEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([])
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventVendor, EventProduct,
        EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventType, EventResult, EventSeverity,
        EventOriginalType, EventOriginalUid, EventUid, EventOriginalResultDetails,
        Dvc, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcIpAddr, DvcScopeId, DvcOs,
        ActorUsername, ActorUsernameType, ActorUserId, ActorUserIdType, ActorUserSid, ActorUserUid,
        ActorSessionId, ActingProcessId, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
        TargetFilePath, TargetFilePathType, TargetFileName, TargetFileDirectory, TargetFileSize, TargetFileSHA256,
        SrcFilePath, SrcFilePathType, SrcFileName,
        FilePath = TargetFilePath, FileName = TargetFileName, Hash = TargetFileSHA256, HashType,
        User = ActorUsername, Process = ActingProcessName,
        ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActingProcessEntityKey, ActorUserEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds,
        DvcEntityKey, SrcFileEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey, TargetApplicationEntityKey,
        TargetFileEntityKey, AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, eventtype_in=eventtype_in, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix, actorusername_has_any=actorusername_has_any, targetfilepath_has_any=targetfilepath_has_any, srcfilepath_has_any=srcfilepath_has_any, hashes_has_any=hashes_has_any, dvchostname_has_any=dvchostname_has_any, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
